backgrounds: Single primary location: an outdoor cemetery/graveyard set. Softly blurred gravestones dot a grassy field, with silhouetted mourners (out-of-focus black-clad figures) visible in the far background, a hazy hill/horizon line, a pale overcast sky, and a few evergreen trees at the tree line. Many shots are framed through an extreme foreground of blurred white flowers (daisies) that arch into the top and bottom of the frame like a natural vignette, suggesting a floral wreath or grave arrangement just in front of the camera. The scene reads as a single continuous funeral/burial moment shot from a few slightly different camera distances and focal depths (wide two-shot vs. tight close-up on faces), not multiple distinct locations. The title/credit card at the end cuts to a flat solid-black background with no set at all.
props: Blurred white/yellow-centered flowers (daisies) used as a foreground framing device
Gravestones (grey, rounded-top headstones) scattered across the lawn
A pair of black-framed glasses held/fidgeted with in the male character's hand
Small pearl stud earrings on the female character
Black funeral attire: oversized black coat/blazer on the male character, white shirt and black tie underneath
Brown wool/felted turtleneck sweater and black skirt on the female character
Yellow torn-paper/tape graphic banner reading 'NEW EPISODE DAILY' used in the end card
On-screen bold white caption text (karaoke-style subtitles) burned into every shot
lighting_notes: Flat, soft, overcast daylight typical of stop-motion outdoor sets — diffuse light with minimal hard shadows, giving an even, slightly cool-neutral exposure on the felt figures. Background is intentionally thrown out of focus with a shallow depth of field (strong bokeh on flowers, gravestones, and mourners) to isolate the two foreground characters, who stay in crisp focus throughout.
color_palette: Warm skin-tone peach/tan (felt character faces and hands)
Black (male character's coat, both characters' formal bottoms, gravestone shadows)
Golden yellow accent (title text and end-card tape graphic)
visual_complexity_notes: The set is minimal and stylized: essentially one location (graveyard), one recurring two-shot composition, and a shallow-focus technique that reduces background detail to soft, abstract shapes. This appears deliberate — it keeps visual attention entirely on the two stop-motion characters' exaggerated facial expressions and dialogue delivery rather than on environmental storytelling, which fits a fast-paced, dialogue/punchline-driven comedy short. The felt/wool material texture is the main source of visual richness, standing in for background complexity.
